name: OPLS-AA 2024 Lennard-Jones refits (CAPS refit, exp)
source: CAPS refits to liquid densities and heats of vaporisation at 298.15 K (NIST ThermoML / WebBook), with CAPS's own NPT MD (bench/ff/liquid_validate.py)

pairs.name: opls_753
pairs.comment: CAPS refit (exp): nitrile N (RCN) epsilon 0.17 -> 0.25 kcal/mol, sigma 3.20 A kept. Acetonitrile density +0.82 %, dHvap -0.12 kcal/mol; propionitrile -0.59 %, -0.15 (with the 2024 value: -3.21 % / -0.80 and -3.21 % / -0.83). Best of four trials (bench/ff/open/nitrile_lj, trial A)

pairs.name: opls_203
pairs.comment: CAPS refit (exp): disulfide S epsilon 0.355 -> 0.275 kcal/mol, sigma 3.60 -> 3.50 A (OPLS-AA 2024 gives 203 the sulfide S 202's values; the sulfides themselves stay within 0.35 kcal/mol and are not changed). Dimethyl disulfide density +0.03 %, dHvap +0.01 kcal/mol; diethyl disulfide dHvap +0.05 (with the 2024 value: +2.49 % / +1.74 and dHvap +1.75). Best of six trials (bench/ff/open/disulfide_lj, trial S6)

pairs.name: opls_468
pairs.comment: CAPS refit (exp): ester methoxy C epsilon 0.066 -> 0.075 kcal/mol, sigma 3.50 A kept. Methyl acetate and methyl methacrylate both carry 468 and move together, so this shares the error: methyl acetate density -1.73 %, dHvap -0.34 kcal/mol; methyl methacrylate +0.31 %, +0.22 (with the 2024 value: -2.35 % / -0.59 and -0.22 % / -0.04). Five trials (bench/ff/open/methoxy_lj, trial M5); PMMA's methoxy C is 468 too

notes: optional overlay on oplsaa2024.json (caps ff apply --overlay oplsaa2024-lj-refit.json, or with the rubber refits: --overlay oplsaa2024-rubber-refit.json,oplsaa2024-lj-refit.json); the base library keeps the 2024 values

known limit, not refitted: glassy polymers (PMMA, PS, PVAc, PET) come out 3.5-8 % below their experimental glass density with OPLS-AA 2024 and this overlay; their melts are already 2-5 % light while the monomer liquids are right (bench/ff/open/oplsaa2024_glass_density_limitation.md)
